IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, loose dark
brown curls peeks out from a deep gray
acid-washed hood. She wears a cropped zip
hoodie over a black leather corset, a studded wide
belt, and a black leather pleated mini skirt. Studded
fingerless gloves and a studded black shoulder bag
complete the look. Her expression is serious, with a
bold red lip. A city street at night with soft ambient
light. Palette of charcoal, black, and silver studs.
Edgy and dramatic, in the style of a night-out
street-style photo.
